name: Angles on lines, in triangles, in polygons
definition: Angles on a straight line add to 180 degrees, angles round a point add to 360, and the angles of a triangle add to 180. Almost every angle chase is those three facts applied in turn until the unknown is cornered.
recognizeWhen: find the marked angle in the diagram
how many degrees is the angle at the centre
the shape is a regular polygon
misconceptions: I assumed an angle was a right angle because it looked like one in the picture.
I used the triangle rule on a shape that was not a triangle.
I found an angle correctly but then reported the wrong one of the two at that point.
